feeds.title: Biomimicry Institute
feeds.description: The Biomimicry Institute empowers people to create nature-inspired solutions for a healthy planet. AskingNature, the Biomimicry Institute's blog, showcases biomimicry thought leaders in research, sustainability, resilience, and regenerative design.

feeds.title: Learn Biomimicry Blog
feeds.description: Biomimicry is a practice, the more you do it, the better you get at it. And through its practice, you'll be able to design cities, products, and businesses that create conditions conducive to life. We work with world-class biomimicry practitioners, influential educators, and accomplished professionals to bring you Nature's winning strategies.

feeds.title: Biomimicry for Young Children Blog
feeds.description: Biomimicry is an exciting way to inspire young children to be creative, and curious, and to observe the world. Children come to understand how animals and plants can be used as a platform upon which ideas and inventions can be developed.

feeds.title: The Biomimetic Uprising Blog
feeds.description: The Biomimetic Uprising blog is dedicated to sharing information and updates about biomimetic dentistry. This blog explores the principles and benefits of biomimetic dentistry, emphasizing the preservation of natural tooth structure and long-term oral health. Visit their website to stay up to date with the latest insights and advancements in this field.

feeds.title: The Alleman Center Blog
feeds.description: The Alleman Center's blog is dedicated to providing valuable information and resources on oral health and dental care. Their articles cover a wide range of topics, including preventive dentistry, restorative treatments, and tips for maintaining optimal oral hygiene. Visit their website to explore their blog and gain insights into maintaining a healthy smile.

feeds.title: Synapse Blog
feeds.description: Biomimicry 3.8 is the world's leading bio-inspired consultancy. Synapse is where Biomimicry 3.8 staff experts share what we're excited about in biomimicry, our inspirations from nature's genius, and tips and resources for doing biomimicry.

feeds.title: Fast Company » Biomimicry
feeds.description: Fast Company inspires a new breed of innovative and creative thought leaders who are actively inventing the future of business. Read Fast Company's articles and posts related to Biomimicry with a unique editorial focus on innovation in technology, leadership, and design.

feeds.title: Boing Boing » Biomimicry
feeds.description: Boing Boing is a directory of wonderful things. Read posts about biomimicry written by David Pescovitz, Andrea James, Mark Frauenfelder, and Cory Doctorow.

feeds.title: Biomimicry Frontiers Blog
feeds.description: Biomimicry Frontiers applies biomimicry and biophilic designs to transform the built environment towards greater harmony with nature. This blog is a collection of stories from Biomimicry Frontiers that includes ideas, applications, and our journey towards a new paradigm of design.

feeds.title: Biomimicry Innovation Lab Blog
feeds.description: Biomimicry Innovation Lab has shaped responsible innovation with clients and collaborators worldwide. Our mission is to develop regenerative innovations fit for the 21st-century challenges focusing on environmental and socio-economic impacts. Let us show you how we can develop these unique solutions by thinking about ecosystems and radical resource efficiency.
